senses.en: someone who greatly enjoys or admires a person or thing
a device or object moved to create a cooling airflow
to move air towards something, or make a feeling stronger

ex.en: As a football fan, I rarely miss a match.
ex.zh: 作为一名足球迷，我几乎不错过任何一场比赛。

ex.en: Sports fans can strengthen local communities by supporting neighbourhood teams and participating in shared events.
ex.zh: 体育迷可以通过支持社区球队、参与共同活动来增强当地社区的凝聚力。

tip: 表示“……的爱好者”用a fan of。

senses.en: extremely good or enjoyable
strange and imaginative, rather than realistic
extremely large in amount or degree

ex.en: We had a fantastic view of the mountains from our balcony.
ex.zh: 从阳台望去，山景美极了。

ex.en: Community sports programmes offer young people a fantastic opportunity to develop teamwork skills and build confidence.
ex.zh: 社区体育项目为年轻人提供了培养团队合作技能和增强自信的绝佳机会。

tip: 表示“极好的”偏口语；正式写作可用excellent。

senses.en: An imagined situation that is unlikely to happen
Stories featuring magic, imaginary worlds, or impossible events

ex.en: Living in a castle was my favourite childhood fantasy.
ex.zh: 住在城堡里是我童年时最喜欢的幻想。

ex.en: Fantasy literature can encourage young readers to explore moral questions through imaginary worlds and unusual characters.
ex.zh: 奇幻文学可以鼓励年轻读者通过虚构世界和不同寻常的角色探索道德问题。

tip: 具体幻想可数；表示奇幻文学类型时通常不可数。

senses.en: land and buildings used for growing crops or raising animals
to grow crops or raise animals for food or other products

ex.en: We bought fresh eggs from a nearby farm.
ex.zh: 我们从附近的农场买了新鲜鸡蛋。

ex.en: Small farms can support local food supplies while creating employment opportunities in rural communities.
ex.zh: 小型农场既能支持当地食品供应，也能为农村社区创造就业机会。

col: work on a farm｜在农场工作
tip: 表示在农场通常用on a farm，不用in。

senses.en: someone who grows crops or raises animals on a farm

ex.en: The farmer feeds her chickens before the sun rises.
ex.zh: 这位农民在日出前给她的鸡喂食。

ex.en: Small farmers need reliable access to water and affordable technology to maintain production during dry periods.
ex.zh: 小农户需要可靠的水源和负担得起的技术，才能在干旱期间维持生产。

tip: farmer指人，farm指农场，farming指农业生产。

senses.en: A style of clothing or behaviour popular at a particular time
A particular way of doing something
Make or shape something, often using simple materials

ex.en: My sister follows fashion but rarely buys expensive clothes.
ex.zh: 我姐姐关注时尚，但很少买昂贵的衣服。

ex.en: The fashion industry can reduce its environmental impact by producing durable clothing and using recycled materials.
ex.zh: 时装行业可以通过生产耐穿的衣服和使用回收材料来减少对环境的影响。

col: in a similar fashion｜以类似的方式
tip: 表方式时常用in a ... fashion，语气较正式。

senses.en: moving or happening at high speed
at high speed or within a short time
to eat no food for a period of time

ex.en: We caught a fast train and arrived before lunch.
ex.zh: 我们赶上了一班快车，在午饭前就到了。

ex.en: Fast internet connections allow rural businesses to reach wider markets and compete with companies in major cities.
ex.zh: 高速网络连接使乡村企业能够进入更广阔的市场，并与大城市的公司竞争。

tip: fast本身可作副词，不能说fastly。

senses.en: a substance stored in bodies or used in cooking
having a large amount of body fat

ex.en: Let the soup cool, then remove the fat.
ex.zh: 让汤凉下来，再撇去油脂。

ex.en: Although the body needs some fat, excessive consumption can increase the risk of certain health problems.
ex.zh: 虽然人体需要一定的脂肪，但摄入过多会增加某些健康问题的风险。

tip: 用fat形容人可能冒犯；谈健康宜用overweight。

senses.en: A male parent.
A man who established or greatly influenced a field.
To become the biological father of a child.

ex.en: Her father taught her to ride a bicycle.
ex.zh: 她爸爸教她骑自行车。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can allow fathers to take a more active role in raising their children.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排可以让父亲更积极地参与养育子女。

col: the father of modern medicine｜现代医学之父
tip: father较正式，dad更口语化；父亲节用Father's Day。

senses.en: Something wrong with an object, system, or person's character
Responsibility for a mistake or something bad that happened
A break in rock where sections have moved apart

ex.en: A small electrical fault stopped the washing machine yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天一个小小的电路故障让洗衣机停止了运转。

ex.en: Regular inspections can identify a structural fault before it threatens the safety of residents.
ex.zh: 定期检查能在结构缺陷危及居民安全之前发现它。

tip: It's my fault表示“是我的错”，不用mistake替换。

senses.en: liked more than any other of the same kind
a person or thing someone likes best
the competitor considered most likely to win

ex.en: This little bakery sells my favourite kind of bread.
ex.zh: 这家小面包店卖我最喜欢的那种面包。

ex.en: Public libraries allow readers to discover new authors as well as revisit their favourite books without additional cost.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆让读者无需额外花费，既能发现新作家，也能重读自己最喜爱的书。

col: a firm favourite｜一直备受喜爱的人或物
the favourite to win｜夺冠热门
tip: 英式拼写favourite，美式favorite；一般不用most修饰。

senses.en: An unpleasant feeling about danger or something bad happening.
To feel afraid or worried about someone or something.

ex.en: She held my hand because of her fear of heights.
ex.zh: 她因为恐高而握住了我的手。

ex.en: Fear of failure may prevent students from asking questions, especially in highly competitive learning environments.
ex.zh: 对失败的恐惧可能使学生不敢提问，在竞争激烈的学习环境中尤其如此。

col: fear for someone's safety｜担心某人的安全
tip: fear sth是害怕某事；fear for sb是为某人担忧。

senses.en: One of the light, soft structures covering a bird's body.

ex.en: A white feather floated gently onto the garden path.
ex.zh: 一根白色羽毛轻轻飘落在花园小径上。

ex.en: Feathers help birds maintain their body temperature, allowing them to survive in colder environments.
ex.zh: 羽毛帮助鸟类维持体温，使它们能在较寒冷的环境中生存。

col: as light as a feather｜轻如鸿毛
tip: feather指单根羽毛；fur通常指动物浓密的毛。

senses.en: The second month of the year.

ex.en: My sister starts her new job in February.
ex.zh: 我姐姐二月份开始新工作。

ex.en: The community centre will introduce additional evening classes in February to meet growing demand.
ex.zh: 社区中心将在二月份增设夜间课程，以满足不断增长的需求。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

senses.en: Give food to someone or an animal, or eat food.
Food given to farm animals.
A regularly updated stream of online content.

ex.en: Please feed the cat before you leave for school.
ex.zh: 请在上学前喂一下猫。

ex.en: School meal programmes help feed children whose families cannot consistently afford nutritious food.
ex.zh: 学校供餐计划帮助那些家庭无法持续负担营养食物的儿童吃上饭。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为fed；feed on表示以……为食。

senses.en: comments about performance or work that help someone improve

ex.en: My tutor gave me helpful feedback on my essay.
ex.zh: 导师针对我的作文给了我有用的反馈。

ex.en: Regular feedback enables students to identify weaknesses and develop more effective strategies for independent learning.
ex.zh: 定期反馈能帮助学生发现薄弱之处，并制定更有效的自主学习策略。

tip: 不可数，不说a feedback或feedbacks；用some feedback。

senses.en: Experience an emotion, physical sensation, or personal belief.
Touch something to discover its texture, shape, or position.
The quality something has when touched or experienced.

ex.en: I feel much warmer with this soft blanket.
ex.zh: 盖着这条柔软的毯子，我觉得暖和多了。

ex.en: Residents often feel safer when public spaces are well lit and regularly maintained by local authorities.
ex.zh: 当公共空间照明充足且由地方政府定期维护时，居民往往更有安全感。

col: feel strongly about｜对……有强烈看法
feel like doing something｜想做某事
get a feel for｜逐渐了解
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为felt；feel后可直接接形容词。

senses.en: An emotional state or response to something
A physical sensation or the ability to sense touch
An impression or belief not necessarily supported by evidence

ex.en: A feeling of relief washed over me after the exam.
ex.zh: 考试结束后，我顿时感到如释重负。

ex.en: A strong feeling of belonging can improve students' confidence and encourage participation in school activities.
ex.zh: 强烈的归属感可以增强学生的自信，并鼓励他们参与学校活动。

col: a feeling of relief｜如释重负的感觉
hurt someone's feelings｜伤害某人的感情
tip: feelings常指感情；have a feeling that表示直觉。

senses.en: A special occasion when people celebrate a tradition or event
An organised series of performances or other cultural events

ex.en: Our town holds a lantern festival every autumn.
ex.zh: 我们镇每年秋天都会举办灯会。

ex.en: An annual arts festival can attract visitors while providing local performers with valuable opportunities to reach wider audiences.
ex.zh: 一年一度的艺术节既能吸引游客，也能为当地表演者提供接触更多观众的宝贵机会。

col: hold a festival｜举办节庆活动
tip: festival强调庆祝或系列活动，不一定是放假的holiday。

senses.en: a body temperature higher than normal, usually caused by illness
intense excitement shared by a person or group

ex.en: He stayed in bed because he had a fever.
ex.zh: 他因为发烧而卧床休息。

ex.en: A persistent fever may indicate an infection and should be assessed by a qualified healthcare professional.
ex.zh: 持续发热可能意味着感染，应由合格的医疗专业人员进行评估。

tip: 表示发烧常说have a fever，也可说have a temperature。

senses.en: Not many; a small number of countable things.
A small number of people or things.

ex.en: There were few customers in the shop this morning.
ex.zh: 今天上午店里的顾客很少。

ex.en: Few rural communities have access to the specialist medical services available in major cities.
ex.zh: 很少有农村社区能获得大城市所提供的专科医疗服务。

col: few and far between｜少之又少
tip: few表几乎没有，a few表有几个；均接可数名词复数。

senses.en: a thin thread forming part of a material or tissue
plant material in food that helps digestion

ex.en: A loose fibre was sticking out of my scarf.
ex.zh: 我的围巾上有一根松脱的纤维伸了出来。

ex.en: A diet rich in fibre can support digestive health and help people feel full for longer.
ex.zh: 富含膳食纤维的饮食有助于消化健康，并能延长饱腹感。

tip: 美式拼写为 fiber；膳食纤维义通常不可数。

senses.en: Stories about imagined people and events.
Something invented that is presented as true.

ex.en: My sister reads fiction on the train every morning.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天早上在火车上读小说。

ex.en: Reading fiction can help young people understand unfamiliar perspectives and develop greater empathy for others.
ex.zh: 阅读小说能帮助年轻人理解陌生的视角，并更加体谅他人。

col: a work of fiction｜一部小说作品
tip: 统称小说时不可数；一部小说可说a work of fiction。

senses.en: an area of land used for crops or farm animals
a particular area of study or work
an area of ground used for playing a sport

ex.en: We watched sheep grazing in the field behind our cottage.
ex.zh: 我们看着羊群在小屋后面的牧场上吃草。

ex.en: Research in the field of renewable energy could create employment opportunities and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 可再生能源领域的研究可以创造就业机会，并减少对化石燃料的依赖。

tip: 表示研究或工作领域时，常用in the field of。

ex.en: Fifteen students joined the club.
ex.zh: 十五名学生参加了社团。

ex.en: We rested for fifteen minutes.
ex.zh: 我们休息了十五分钟。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

ex.en: Our classroom is on the fifth floor.
ex.zh: 我们的教室在五楼。

ex.en: She finished fifth in the race.
ex.zh: 她在比赛中获得第五名。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: To use physical force against another person or group.
To try hard to stop something or achieve a goal.
An occasion of physical conflict or a determined effort against something.

ex.en: The two cats fought over a sunny window seat.
ex.zh: 两只猫为了窗边一个有阳光的位置打了起来。

ex.en: Governments should fight poverty by improving access to education, healthcare, and stable employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 政府应通过改善教育和医疗服务的可及性、增加稳定就业机会来消除贫困。

col: get into a fight｜卷入打斗
tip: 过去式、过去分词均为fought；fight for表示争取。

senses.en: a number expressing an amount, especially in official information
a person, their outline, or the shape of their body
to think or decide something after considering it

ex.en: She checked the final figure on the bill.
ex.zh: 她核对了账单上的最终金额。

ex.en: Recent employment figures suggest that investment in public transport can create substantial opportunities for local workers.
ex.zh: 近期就业数据显示，投资公共交通能为当地劳动者创造大量机会。

tip: 数据常用复数figures；figure out意为弄懂。

senses.en: Stored information on a computer, or an organized collection of papers.
To store documents systematically or submit them to an authority.
A rough metal tool used to smooth or shape surfaces.

ex.en: I saved the file before switching off my laptop.
ex.zh: 我关掉笔记本电脑之前保存了文件。

ex.en: Public institutions should store confidential files securely to prevent unauthorized access and protect citizens' personal information.
ex.zh: 公共机构应安全存储机密文件，以防止未经授权的访问并保护公民的个人信息。

col: file a complaint｜正式提出投诉
tip: file a complaint 指正式投诉，不是把投诉归档。

senses.en: Make or become full
Occupy an empty position or meet a particular need

ex.en: Please fill the jug with water for our guests.
ex.zh: 请把水壶装满水，给客人们喝。

ex.en: Local training programmes can help fill vacancies in essential services such as healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 地方培训项目可以帮助填补医疗和教育等基本服务领域的职位空缺。

col: fill in a form｜填写表格
fill a vacancy｜填补职位空缺
tip: fill A with B表示用B装满A；be filled with表示充满。

senses.en: a story or events recorded as moving pictures
to record moving pictures using a camera
a thin layer, or material used to record photographs

ex.en: We watched a funny film after dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天晚饭后，我们看了一部有趣的电影。

ex.en: Documentary films can raise public awareness of environmental problems by showing their effects on local communities.
ex.zh: 纪录片可以通过展示环境问题对当地社区的影响，提高公众的环保意识。

col: a thin film of oil｜一层薄薄的油膜
tip: 表示电影时，film偏英式，movie偏美式。

senses.en: a flat body part or structure aiding movement or stability
a flat rubber covering worn on a foot for swimming

ex.en: We spotted a shark's fin just above the water.
ex.zh: 我们看见一个鲨鱼鳍刚刚露出水面。

ex.en: Changes in fin shape can affect how efficiently fish move through different aquatic environments.
ex.zh: 鱼鳍形状的变化会影响鱼类在不同水生环境中的游动效率。

tip: 指潜水脚蹼时常用复数fins。

senses.en: coming last in a series or process
settled and not open to further change or discussion
a competition's last match, or an examination ending a course

ex.en: We packed the final box and locked the door.
ex.zh: 我们装好最后一个箱子，锁上了门。

ex.en: The final stage of the research involved comparing energy consumption across several types of housing.
ex.zh: 研究的最后阶段是比较几种不同类型住房的能源消耗。

tip: finally是副词；final作名词可指决赛或期末考试。

senses.en: After a long wait, delay, or effort.
Used to introduce the last point or action.

ex.en: After searching all morning, I finally found my keys.
ex.zh: 找了一上午后，我终于找到了钥匙。

ex.en: Finally, governments should invest in reliable public transport to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 最后，政府应投资建设可靠的公共交通，以缓解交通拥堵和城市空气污染。

tip: 表示终于常置于实义动词前；引出最后一点常置句首。

senses.en: To discover something or locate what you were looking for.
To have a particular opinion or experience of something.
Something useful or valuable that someone discovers.

ex.en: I finally found my keys inside my coat pocket.
ex.zh: 我终于在外套口袋里找到了钥匙。

ex.en: Many students find online courses convenient, although some struggle to stay motivated without classroom interaction.
ex.zh: 许多学生觉得网络课程很方便，但有些人在缺少课堂互动时难以保持学习动力。

col: find a solution｜找到解决办法
find it difficult to｜觉得做某事困难
a valuable find｜有价值的发现物
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为found；find＋宾语＋形容词。

senses.en: Good, satisfactory, healthy, or of high quality.
Made of very small particles or having little thickness.
Money that must be paid as punishment for breaking rules.

ex.en: I feel fine now, so let's go for a walk.
ex.zh: 我现在感觉挺好的，我们去散步吧。

ex.en: A substantial fine may discourage companies from dumping industrial waste into rivers and damaging local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 高额罚款可能会阻止企业向河流倾倒工业废物、破坏当地生态系统。

tip: fine作动词也指罚款：fine sb for sth。

senses.en: one of the long movable parts of a hand
to touch or handle something with your fingers

ex.en: She wore a silver ring on her middle finger.
ex.zh: 她的中指上戴着一枚银戒指。

ex.en: Tasks requiring precise finger movements can help young children develop coordination before they learn to write.
ex.zh: 需要手指精细动作的任务可以帮助幼儿在学习写字前发展协调能力。

col: point a finger at｜用手指指向；指责
tip: 通常不包括拇指；拇指专称thumb。

senses.en: to complete something or reach its end
the final part or end of something
the appearance or texture of a completed surface

ex.en: I'll finish washing the dishes before we go.
ex.zh: 我们出门前，我会把碗洗完。

ex.en: Students who finish their assignments early have more time to review feedback and improve their understanding.
ex.zh: 提前完成作业的学生有更多时间查看反馈并加深理解。

tip: 表示做完某事用finish doing，不用finish to do。

senses.en: Burning that produces heat and light, sometimes causing damage.
To make someone leave their job.
To shoot a gun or launch a weapon.

ex.en: We warmed our hands by the fire after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们在炉火旁暖手。

ex.en: Regular safety inspections can reduce the risk of fire in older residential buildings with outdated electrical systems.
ex.zh: 定期安全检查可以降低电气系统老化的旧住宅楼发生火灾的风险。

tip: catch fire指开始着火；be on fire指正在燃烧。

senses.en: A person trained to put out fires and rescue people

ex.en: The firefighter showed us how to use the hose.
ex.zh: 那位消防员向我们演示了如何使用消防水带。

ex.en: Every firefighter requires regular training to respond safely and effectively to emergencies in increasingly complex urban environments.
ex.zh: 每位消防员都需要定期接受培训，以便在日益复杂的城市环境中安全、有效地应对紧急情况。

col: a trained firefighter｜训练有素的消防员
tip: firefighter不区分性别，比fireman更通用。

senses.en: A man whose job is to put out fires.

ex.en: The fireman rescued a kitten from the smoky kitchen.
ex.zh: 这名男消防员从烟雾弥漫的厨房里救出了一只小猫。

ex.en: The fireman explained that regular safety inspections could prevent many accidents in residential buildings.
ex.zh: 这名男消防员解释说，定期安全检查可以预防住宅楼内的许多事故。

col: a brave fireman｜勇敢的男消防员
a volunteer fireman｜志愿男消防员
tip: 复数为firemen；现代通用表达多用中性的firefighter。

senses.en: coming before all others in order or time
before anything or anyone else

ex.en: This is my first visit to the seaside.
ex.zh: 这是我第一次到海边来。

ex.en: Governments should first improve public transport before encouraging residents to give up private cars.
ex.zh: 政府应先改善公共交通，再鼓励居民放弃私家车。

tip: at first指起初；first可用于列举第一点。

senses.en: an animal living in water with fins; its edible flesh
to try to catch fish

ex.en: We watched small fish swimming under the wooden bridge.
ex.zh: 我们看着小鱼在木桥下游动。

ex.en: Eating locally caught fish can support coastal communities, provided that fishing practices protect marine ecosystems.
ex.zh: 只要捕捞方式能保护海洋生态系统，食用本地捕获的鱼就能支持沿海社区。

tip: 表示多条鱼通常仍用fish；鱼肉为不可数名词。

senses.en: someone who catches fish for work or pleasure

ex.en: The fisherman pulled his net onto the wooden boat.
ex.zh: 渔民把渔网拉上了木船。

ex.en: Each fisherman in the coastal village depends on healthy marine ecosystems to maintain a reliable income.
ex.zh: 这个沿海村庄的每位渔民都依靠健康的海洋生态系统来维持稳定收入。

tip: 复数为fishermen；中性表达可用fisher。

senses.en: To be the right size, shape, or type for something.
Physically healthy and strong, especially through exercise.
Suitable or good enough for a particular purpose.

ex.en: These boots fit perfectly, even with my thick socks.
ex.zh: 即使穿着厚袜子，这双靴子也非常合脚。

ex.en: Public exercise facilities can help older adults stay fit while strengthening social connections within their communities.
ex.zh: 公共健身设施可以帮助老年人保持健康，同时加强他们与社区内其他人的联系。

tip: 衣物fit指尺寸合适；suit多指款式或颜色适合。

ex.en: I have five storybooks.
ex.zh: 我有五本故事书。

ex.en: The game starts in five minutes.
ex.zh: 游戏五分钟后开始。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: set and not changing or adjustable
securely attached in one position

ex.en: This cafe offers lunch at a fixed price.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆以固定价格供应午餐。

ex.en: Workers on fixed incomes may struggle to afford basic necessities when inflation significantly increases the cost of living.
ex.zh: 当通货膨胀大幅推高生活成本时，收入固定的劳动者可能难以负担基本生活必需品。

tip: fixed price是固定价格；fixed也可作fix的过去分词。

senses.en: a cloth symbol representing a country, group, or organisation
to mark something as needing attention
to become weaker or less energetic

ex.en: A bright flag fluttered above the school gate.
ex.zh: 一面鲜艳的旗帜在校门上方飘扬。

ex.en: Teachers should flag potential learning difficulties early so that students can receive appropriate support.
ex.zh: 教师应尽早指出潜在的学习困难，以便学生获得适当的支持。

tip: 动词过去式flagged，进行式flagging，双写g。

senses.en: A journey through the air, especially in an aircraft.
The act or ability of moving through the air.
A continuous set of stairs between floors or landings.

ex.en: Our flight leaves early, so we should pack tonight.
ex.zh: 我们的航班出发很早，所以今晚应该收拾好行李。

ex.en: Reducing the number of short domestic flights could lower emissions where reliable rail alternatives already exist.
ex.zh: 在已有可靠铁路替代方案的地区，减少短途国内航班可以降低排放。

col: a flight of stairs｜一段楼梯
tip: a flight of stairs指两层或平台之间的一段楼梯。

senses.en: Water covering land that is normally dry.
To cover with water or become covered with water.
A large amount of something arriving at once.

ex.en: The flood left our garden covered in thick mud.
ex.zh: 洪水退去后，我们的花园覆满了厚厚的淤泥。

ex.en: Restoring wetlands can reduce flood risks by allowing excess rainwater to spread and drain naturally.
ex.zh: 恢复湿地可以让多余雨水自然扩散和排走，从而降低洪灾风险。

col: a flood of complaints｜大量涌来的投诉
tip: 读音与 blood 的元音相同，不与 food 押韵。

senses.en: The surface inside a building that people walk on.
A level of a building.
The bottom surface of a sea, valley, or similar area.

ex.en: My keys fell onto the kitchen floor again.
ex.zh: 我的钥匙又掉到厨房地板上了。

ex.en: Converting unused upper floors into apartments could help cities address housing shortages without expanding outwards.
ex.zh: 把闲置的较高楼层改建成公寓，有助于城市在不向外扩张的情况下缓解住房短缺。

tip: 英式first floor是二楼；美式first floor是一楼。

senses.en: powder made by grinding grain, used especially in baking
to cover a surface or food lightly with flour

ex.en: Add the flour slowly and stir until smooth.
ex.zh: 慢慢加入面粉，搅拌至顺滑。

ex.en: Replacing some refined flour with wholemeal flour can increase the fibre content of everyday foods.
ex.zh: 用全麦面粉替代部分精制面粉，可以提高日常食品中的膳食纤维含量。

col: flour a surface｜在台面上撒面粉
tip: flour通常不可数，且与flower同音。

senses.en: The often colourful part of a plant that produces seeds.
To produce flowers.

ex.en: She placed fresh flowers in a vase by the window.
ex.zh: 她把鲜花插进窗边的花瓶里。

ex.en: Planting native flowers in urban parks can support pollinating insects and improve local biodiversity.
ex.zh: 在城市公园种植本地花卉能够帮助传粉昆虫生存，并改善当地生物多样性。

tip: flower既可作名词“花”，也可作动词“开花”。

senses.en: an infectious illness causing fever, aches, and tiredness

ex.en: She stayed in bed all weekend with the flu.
ex.zh: 她得了流感，整个周末都卧床休息。

ex.en: Annual flu vaccinations can help protect vulnerable people and reduce pressure on hospitals during winter.
ex.zh: 每年接种流感疫苗有助于保护易感人群，并减轻冬季医院的压力。

tip: flu通常不可数；英式常说have flu，美式常加the。

senses.en: A wind instrument held sideways and played by blowing across it.

ex.en: She practises the flute by her bedroom window every afternoon.
ex.zh: 她每天下午都在卧室窗边练习长笛。

ex.en: Learning to play the flute can develop concentration and encourage children to participate in musical ensembles.
ex.zh: 学习吹长笛可以培养专注力，并鼓励儿童参加合奏团体。

tip: 英式常称演奏者为flautist，美式常用flutist。

senses.en: to move through the air using wings
to travel in or control an aircraft
a small insect with two wings, often found near food

ex.en: Small birds fly over our garden every morning.
ex.zh: 每天早晨都有小鸟飞过我们的花园。

ex.en: Choosing to travel by train rather than fly can significantly reduce the environmental impact of short journeys.
ex.zh: 短途出行选择火车而非飞机，可以显著减少对环境的影响。

col: a swarm of flies｜一群苍蝇
tip: 动词变化fly–flew–flown；苍蝇复数为flies。

senses.en: direct attention or effort towards one particular thing
the main subject receiving attention or effort
image sharpness, or the point where light rays meet

ex.en: Please turn the music down so I can focus.
ex.zh: 请把音乐调小一点，好让我集中注意力。

ex.en: Governments should focus on affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 政府应重点发展价格合理的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善就业机会的可达性。

tip: focus on后接名词或动名词；不要说focus in。

senses.en: a thick cloud near the ground that limits visibility
to become or make a surface covered with fine droplets

ex.en: Thick fog hid the hills behind our house.
ex.zh: 浓雾遮住了我们屋后的山丘。

ex.en: Dense fog can disrupt transport networks, causing flight cancellations and increasing the risk of road accidents.
ex.zh: 浓雾可能扰乱交通网络，导致航班取消，并增加道路事故的风险。

tip: fog比mist更浓；fog up常指玻璃蒙上雾气。

senses.en: People, especially those belonging to a particular group.
Connected with the traditional culture of ordinary people.
Music rooted in the traditions of a community.

ex.en: Local folk gather here to chat every evening.
ex.zh: 当地人每晚都聚在这里聊天。

ex.en: Traditional folk music can help younger generations understand the cultural heritage of their communities.
ex.zh: 传统民间音乐能帮助年轻一代理解自己社区的文化遗产。

tip: 指人们时用复数动词；my folks口语指父母。

senses.en: To move behind someone or along a route.
To act according to instructions, rules, or advice.
To understand what someone says or explains.

ex.en: Follow this path until you reach the wooden bridge.
ex.zh: 沿着这条小路走，直到到达木桥。

ex.en: Schools should teach children how to follow safety guidelines when using digital devices and online services.
ex.zh: 学校应教导儿童在使用数字设备和网络服务时如何遵守安全准则。

col: follow an argument｜理解论证思路
tip: follow直接接宾语：follow me，不加with。

senses.en: Things people or animals eat to live and grow.

ex.en: We packed enough food for a picnic by the lake.
ex.zh: 我们带了足够的食物，准备在湖边野餐。

ex.en: Reducing food waste at home can save money and lower the environmental impact of household consumption.
ex.zh: 减少家庭食物浪费既能省钱，也能降低家庭消费对环境的影响。

tip: 泛指食物时不可数；foods表示不同种类的食物。

senses.en: a game where teams kick a ball into opposing goals
an American game involving carrying, throwing, and kicking an oval ball

ex.en: We play football in the park every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。

ex.en: Local football clubs can strengthen community relationships by bringing together people from different social backgrounds.
ex.zh: 地方足球俱乐部能够聚集不同社会背景的人，从而增进社区联系。

tip: 英式football指足球；美式通常指美式橄榄球。

senses.en: physical power that moves something or changes its shape
to make someone do something against their wishes
physical strength used to control or overpower someone

ex.en: The force of the wind blew my umbrella inside out.
ex.zh: 大风把我的伞吹翻了。

ex.en: Rising housing costs may force essential workers to move further away from the communities they serve.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的住房成本可能迫使必要岗位的工作人员搬离他们服务的社区。

col: force someone to do something｜迫使某人做某事
tip: “迫使某人做某事”用force somebody to do something。

senses.en: From or relating to a country other than your own.
Present where it does not naturally belong.
Unfamiliar to someone or inconsistent with something.

ex.en: My sister enjoys learning foreign languages in her spare time.
ex.zh: 我姐姐喜欢在空闲时间学习外语。

ex.en: Foreign investment can create jobs, but governments should ensure that local communities also benefit from economic growth.
ex.zh: 外国投资可以创造就业机会，但政府应确保当地社区也能从经济增长中受益。

tip: foreign to可指对某人陌生，或与某事不相符。

senses.en: a large area of land covered mainly with trees

ex.en: We followed a narrow path deep into the forest.
ex.zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路走进森林深处。

ex.en: Protecting natural forests helps preserve biodiversity and reduces the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.
ex.zh: 保护天然森林有助于维护生物多样性，并减少大气中的二氧化碳含量。

tip: forest通常指大片森林；wood也可指较小树林。

senses.en: for all future time
very often, especially in an annoying way

ex.en: I wish these sunny afternoons could last forever.
ex.zh: 我希望这些阳光明媚的午后能永远持续下去。

ex.en: Without effective conservation measures, some rare animal species could disappear forever within the next few decades.
ex.zh: 如果没有有效的保护措施，一些珍稀动物物种可能在未来几十年内永远消失。

tip: be forever doing常表示不满：老是做某事。

senses.en: to fail to remember a fact, person, or experience
to fail to do or bring something through not remembering

ex.en: I always forget where I put my reading glasses.
ex.zh: 我总是忘记把老花镜放在哪里了。

ex.en: Students may quickly forget new vocabulary unless they review it regularly and use it in meaningful contexts.
ex.zh: 如果学生不定期复习新词，并在有意义的语境中运用，就可能很快忘记。

col: forget to do something｜忘记做某事
tip: forget to do忘记去做；forget doing忘记做过。

senses.en: Stop blaming someone or feeling angry about what they did.
Officially allow someone not to repay a debt.

ex.en: Can you forgive me for breaking your favourite mug?
ex.zh: 我打碎了你最喜欢的杯子，你能原谅我吗？

ex.en: International lenders may forgive some debts to help poorer countries invest more in healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 国际贷款机构可能减免部分债务，帮助较贫困国家增加医疗和教育投入。

col: forgive someone for something｜原谅某人某事
tip: 用forgive sb for doing sth；过去式forgave，过去分词forgiven。

senses.en: A tool with pointed prongs for picking up food
A place where a road or path divides
Divide into separate branches or directions

ex.en: She picked up a carrot with her fork.
ex.zh: 她用餐叉叉起了一块胡萝卜。

ex.en: Where a rural path forks, clear directions can prevent visitors from entering environmentally sensitive areas.
ex.zh: 在乡间小路分叉处提供清晰指引，可以防止游客进入生态敏感区域。

col: a knife and fork｜一副刀叉
a fork in the road｜道路岔口
tip: 道路forks表示分叉；a fork in the road指岔路口。

senses.en: a type, arrangement, or shape of something
a document with spaces for providing requested information
to develop, create, or combine into something

ex.en: The clouds took the form of a giant rabbit.
ex.zh: 那些云呈现出一只巨兔的形状。

ex.en: Online learning has become a popular form of education because it offers flexibility for working adults.
ex.zh: 在线学习已成为一种受欢迎的教育形式，因为它为在职成年人提供了灵活性。

col: in the form of｜以……的形式
fill in a form｜填写表格
tip: fill in a form是英式说法；美式常用fill out a form。

senses.en: Following established rules or officially recognised procedures.
Suitable for serious occasions rather than relaxed situations.
Organised and structured, especially within an educational institution.

ex.en: You need a formal invitation to attend the ceremony.
ex.zh: 你需要正式邀请才能出席典礼。

ex.en: Formal education provides essential knowledge, while practical experience helps students apply what they have learned.
ex.zh: 正规教育提供必备知识，而实践经验帮助学生运用所学内容。

tip: formal不等于former：前者“正式的”，后者“以前的”。

senses.en: towards the front or a later time
to send something received to another person or place
an attacking player in sports such as football

ex.en: Please step forward when there is space ahead.
ex.zh: 前面有空位时，请向前走一步。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can help countries move forward towards a more sustainable economic future.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源有助于各国迈向更可持续的经济未来。

col: move forward｜向前移动；取得进展
put forward a proposal｜提出建议
tip: look forward to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: to establish an organization, institution, or settlement
past tense and past participle of find

ex.en: My aunt founded a small charity last winter.
ex.zh: 去年冬天，我姑姑创办了一家小型慈善机构。

ex.en: Graduates who found new businesses can create employment opportunities and introduce innovative services to local communities.
ex.zh: 创办新企业的毕业生可以创造就业机会，并为当地社区引入创新服务。

col: found a charity｜创办慈善机构
tip: “创立”的过去式是founded；“找到”的原形是find。

senses.en: the number after three and before five

ex.en: We put four chairs around the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房桌子周围放了四把椅子。

ex.en: The research team compared four methods of reducing household energy use during the winter months.
ex.zh: 研究团队比较了四种减少冬季家庭能源消耗的方法。

tip: four是基数词；表示顺序“第四”用fourth。

ex.en: There are fourteen desks in the room.
ex.zh: 房间里有十四张课桌。

ex.en: She became fourteen in May.
ex.zh: 她五月份满十四岁。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: coming immediately after the third in a sequence
one of four equal parts of a whole

ex.en: Our apartment is on the fourth floor, beside the lift.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓在四楼，就在电梯旁边。

ex.en: The fourth stage of the recycling process involves transforming cleaned plastic into material suitable for new products.
ex.zh: 回收流程的第四阶段是将清洗后的塑料转化为适合制造新产品的材料。

tip: 第四是fourth；forth意为向前，注意拼写。

senses.en: A wild animal with pointed ears and a bushy tail.
To confuse someone or make a problem difficult to solve.

ex.en: A fox slipped through the garden before sunrise.
ex.zh: 日出前，一只狐狸悄悄穿过花园。

ex.en: The red fox can adapt to urban environments where food is readily available from human activity.
ex.zh: 赤狐能够适应城市环境，因为人类活动使食物很容易获取。

col: an urban fox｜城市里的狐狸
tip: 作动词表示“难倒”，主要用于英式非正式语境。

senses.en: a country in western Europe whose capital is Paris

ex.en: We travelled through France by train last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天，我们乘火车游览了法国。

ex.en: France attracts international visitors through its cultural heritage, varied landscapes, and well-developed transport networks.
ex.zh: 法国凭借文化遗产、多样的景观和发达的交通网络吸引国际游客。

tip: 国名France首字母大写，通常不加the。

senses.en: Costing no money.
Able to act or move without being controlled or restricted.
To release someone or something from control or confinement.

ex.en: The café offers free biscuits with every hot drink.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆每卖一杯热饮都会赠送饼干。

ex.en: Providing free public transport could reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment for disadvantaged residents.
ex.zh: 提供免费公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善弱势居民的就业可及性。

tip: be free to do表示可以自由做；for free表示免费。

senses.en: Extremely cold, or cold enough for water to become ice.
The temperature at which water turns into ice.

ex.en: My hands were freezing after waiting outside for the bus.
ex.zh: 在外面等公交车后，我的双手冰冷。

ex.en: Freezing temperatures can damage water pipes and disrupt essential services, particularly in areas with ageing infrastructure.
ex.zh: 冰冻天气可能损坏水管并扰乱基本服务，尤其是在基础设施老化的地区。

col: freezing temperatures｜冰点及以下的气温
tip: I'm freezing表示我冷极了，不一定真的结冰。

senses.en: relating to France, its people, or its language
the language spoken in France and several other countries
the people of France, referred to collectively as the French

ex.en: We bought fresh bread from a small French bakery.
ex.zh: 我们在一家法国面包店买了新鲜面包。

ex.en: Learning French can improve employment prospects in regions where the language is widely used in business.
ex.zh: 在商业活动中广泛使用法语的地区，学习法语可以改善就业前景。

tip: 首字母始终大写；the French表法国人总称。

senses.en: Recently produced or picked, and not preserved or stale.
Clean, cool, and pleasant, especially when describing air.
New or different from what existed or was used before.

ex.en: I bought fresh strawberries from the market this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我在市场买了新鲜草莓。

ex.en: Access to fresh fruit and vegetables is essential for improving diets in low-income urban communities.
ex.zh: 让城市低收入社区居民能获得新鲜果蔬，对改善其饮食至关重要。

tip: fresh water指淡水；fresh air指新鲜空气。

senses.en: the day after Thursday and before Saturday

ex.en: We usually cook dinner together at home on Friday.
ex.zh: 我们通常星期五在家一起做晚饭。

ex.en: Allowing employees to work from home on Friday may reduce commuting pressure and improve job satisfaction.
ex.zh: 允许员工星期五居家办公，可能减轻通勤压力并提高工作满意度。

tip: 首字母大写；on Friday，但 next Friday 前不加 on。

senses.en: An electrical appliance that keeps food and drinks cold.

ex.en: Put the milk back in the fridge, please.
ex.zh: 请把牛奶放回冰箱。

ex.en: Choosing an energy-efficient fridge can reduce household electricity consumption and lower costs over time.
ex.zh: 选择节能冰箱可以减少家庭用电量，并在长期内降低开支。

tip: fridge是refrigerator的常用简短说法。

senses.en: someone you know well, like, and enjoy spending time with

ex.en: I met an old friend at the market yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天在市场遇到了一位老朋友。

ex.en: Maintaining close friendships can improve mental wellbeing, as friends often provide emotional support during difficult periods.
ex.zh: 维持亲密友谊可以改善心理健康，因为朋友常在困难时期提供情感支持。

col: keep in touch with friends｜与朋友保持联系
tip: “与某人交朋友”用make friends with，friends用复数。

senses.en: Kind, welcoming, and pleasant towards other people.
A sports match played outside an official competition.

ex.en: Our new neighbour is friendly and always waves hello.
ex.zh: 我们的新邻居很友善，总是挥手打招呼。

ex.en: Friendly staff can improve patients' experiences and encourage them to seek medical advice earlier.
ex.zh: 亲切的工作人员能改善患者的就医体验，并鼓励他们更早寻求医疗建议。

col: friendly towards newcomers｜对新来者友好
tip: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词，不是副词。

senses.en: a relationship between people who like and support each other

ex.en: Our friendship began when we shared a school desk.
ex.zh: 我们的友谊始于上学时做同桌的日子。

ex.en: Close friendship can improve mental health by providing emotional support during periods of stress.
ex.zh: 亲密的友谊可以在压力时期提供情感支持，从而改善心理健康。

col: a bond of friendship｜友谊的纽带
tip: 泛指友谊不可数；具体一段友谊可数。

senses.en: A small amphibian with long back legs for jumping.

ex.en: A green frog jumped from the stone into our pond.
ex.zh: 一只绿色的青蛙从石头上跳进了我们的池塘。

ex.en: Declining frog populations can indicate environmental damage because these animals are sensitive to changes in water quality.
ex.zh: 青蛙数量下降可能表明环境遭到破坏，因为它们对水质变化十分敏感。

tip: 可数名词，复数为frogs；toad指蟾蜍。

senses.en: showing where someone or something starts or originates
showing what causes something
showing separation, difference, or distance

ex.en: This postcard came from my cousin in the mountains.
ex.zh: 这张明信片是住在山区的表亲寄来的。

ex.en: Students from rural communities may face additional barriers when applying to universities in major cities.
ex.zh: 来自农村社区的学生申请大城市的大学时，可能面临额外障碍。

col: from start to finish｜从头到尾
tip: from表示起点，常与表示终点的to搭配。

senses.en: The forward part or outward-facing surface of something.
Located at or near the forward part of something.
A boundary where masses of warm and cold air meet.

ex.en: Please leave your muddy boots by the front door.
ex.zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子放在前门旁。

ex.en: Placing bicycle racks at the front of public buildings can encourage more residents to cycle.
ex.zh: 在公共建筑前部设置自行车架，可以鼓励更多居民骑车出行。

col: at the front of｜在……的前部
tip: in front of指外部前方；at the front of指前部。

senses.en: Turned into ice or made hard by extreme cold.
Kept at very low temperatures to preserve freshness.
Feeling extremely cold.

ex.en: A frozen puddle cracked beneath my boot this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，一处结冰的水洼被我的靴子踩裂了。

ex.en: Frozen vegetables can help households reduce food waste because they remain usable much longer than fresh produce.
ex.zh: 冷冻蔬菜的保存时间比新鲜农产品长得多，因此可以帮助家庭减少食物浪费。

col: frozen with fear｜吓得动弹不得
tip: 也是freeze的过去分词；过去式为froze。

senses.en: Plant products containing seeds, often sweet and eaten as food.
The useful results of work or effort.
To produce fruit.

ex.en: She packed fresh fruit in my lunch box.
ex.zh: 她在我的午餐盒里放了新鲜水果。

ex.en: Making fresh fruit affordable could encourage healthier eating habits among families with limited incomes.
ex.zh: 让新鲜水果价格更亲民，可以鼓励低收入家庭养成更健康的饮食习惯。

col: the fruits of your labour｜劳动成果
tip: 泛指水果通常不可数；fruits可指种类或成果。

senses.en: material burned or used to produce heat or power
to supply something with fuel
to make a feeling or situation stronger

ex.en: We stopped for fuel before driving into the mountains.
ex.zh: 我们开车进山前停下来加了油。

ex.en: Growing demand for private cars may fuel air pollution unless governments promote cleaner alternatives.
ex.zh: 除非政府推广更清洁的替代出行方式，否则私家车需求的增长可能加剧空气污染。

tip: fuel作动词还可表示助长情绪或推动变化。

senses.en: Containing as much as possible, with no space left.
Including everything, with nothing missing.
Having eaten enough and not wanting more food.

ex.en: The basket is full, so we need another one.
ex.zh: 篮子已经满了，我们得再拿一个。

ex.en: Governments should publish the full results of environmental studies so that citizens can make informed decisions.
ex.zh: 政府应公布环境研究的完整结果，以便公民作出知情决策。

tip: full of表示“充满”；注意full与fool发音不同。

senses.en: Completely or to the greatest possible extent.

ex.en: Make sure your phone is fully charged before leaving.
ex.zh: 出门前确保手机已经充满电。

ex.en: Students benefit most from online learning when they fully understand how to use the available digital tools.
ex.zh: 学生充分了解如何使用现有数字工具时，才能最大程度地从在线学习中受益。

tip: 常修饰分词或形容词，如fully prepared。

senses.en: Enjoyment or pleasure from an activity or experience.
Enjoyable and entertaining.

ex.en: We had so much fun building sandcastles together yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们一起堆沙堡，玩得特别开心。

ex.en: Making physical activity fun can encourage children to exercise regularly and develop healthier habits throughout their lives.
ex.zh: 让体育活动充满乐趣，可以鼓励儿童经常锻炼，并养成终身受益的健康习惯。

tip: fun作名词不可数；funny多指好笑的或奇怪的。

senses.en: a ceremony held to remember and honour someone who has died

ex.en: We brought white flowers to our neighbour's funeral yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们带着白花参加了邻居的葬礼。

ex.en: Funeral traditions vary across cultures, but they often provide families with emotional support during bereavement.
ex.zh: 不同文化的葬礼传统各异，但它们往往能在亲人离世时为家属提供情感支持。

tip: 通常是可数名词：attend a funeral参加葬礼。

senses.en: making you laugh or smile
unusual or difficult to explain

ex.en: That funny story made everyone at the table laugh.
ex.zh: 那个好笑的故事逗得桌边的人都笑了。

ex.en: Teachers sometimes use funny examples to make difficult concepts more memorable and encourage students to participate.
ex.zh: 教师有时会用有趣的例子，让复杂概念更容易记住，并鼓励学生参与。

col: find something funny｜觉得某事好笑
tip: funny侧重好笑或奇怪；fun侧重令人愉快、有趣。

senses.en: the thick soft hair covering some animals
animal skin with hair attached, used for making clothing

ex.en: The cat's wet fur dried quickly in the sunshine.
ex.zh: 猫湿漉漉的毛在阳光下很快就干了。

ex.en: Thick fur helps many mammals survive in cold climates by trapping a layer of warm air.
ex.zh: 浓密的毛通过留住一层暖空气，帮助许多哺乳动物在寒冷气候中生存。

tip: 指动物身上的毛通常不可数；羽毛用feather。

senses.en: The time ahead, or what will happen to someone or something.
Happening or existing at a time after the present.

ex.en: We talked about our future while walking home.
ex.zh: 我们走路回家时聊了聊我们的未来。

ex.en: Governments should invest in renewable energy to protect the environment for future generations worldwide.
ex.zh: 各国政府应投资可再生能源，为世界各地的子孙后代保护环境。

tip: in the future指将来；英式in future常指从今以后。

senses.en: To obtain something useful or increase in amount.
An increase in something or a benefit received.

ex.en: You will gain confidence after a few lessons.
ex.zh: 上几节课后，你就会更有信心。

ex.en: Students can gain valuable practical experience by volunteering for projects that benefit their local communities.
ex.zh: 学生可以通过志愿参与有益于当地社区的项目，获得宝贵的实践经验。

col: gain access to｜获得使用或进入的机会
tip: gain常接经验、信心等；赢比赛通常用win。

ex.en: Our class performed a dance at the New Year gala.
ex.zh: 我们班在新年晚会上表演了舞蹈。

ex.en: The charity gala raised money for children.
ex.zh: 慈善晚会为孩子们筹集了资金。

col: a New Year gala｜新年晚会
tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: an activity or contest played according to rules
wild animals hunted for food or sport, or their meat
willing to try something difficult or unfamiliar

ex.en: We played a board game after dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天晚饭后我们玩了一个桌游。

ex.en: Cooperative games can help children develop communication skills and learn to solve problems together.
ex.zh: 合作型游戏能帮助儿童培养沟通能力，并学会共同解决问题。

tip: 猎物义不可数；be game for表示愿意尝试。

senses.en: an area of land where flowers or vegetables are grown
to grow and care for plants in a garden

ex.en: We picked fresh beans from the garden before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前，我们从菜园里摘了新鲜的豆角。

ex.en: Community gardens can strengthen neighbourhood relationships while giving urban residents access to fresh vegetables and green space.
ex.zh: 社区花园既能加强邻里关系，又能让城市居民获得新鲜蔬菜和绿色空间。

tip: 英式garden可指住宅庭院；美式常用yard。

senses.en: A substance that spreads freely to fill its container.
Gas used as fuel for heating or cooking.
Petrol used to power vehicles, in American English.

ex.en: We use gas to cook our meals at home.
ex.zh: 我们在家用燃气做饭。

ex.en: Reducing greenhouse gas emissions requires investment in cleaner energy and more efficient public transport systems.
ex.zh: 减少温室气体排放需要投资更清洁的能源和更高效的公共交通系统。

tip: 泛指气体通常不可数；多种气体用gases。

senses.en: affecting or involving most people, things, or situations
describing main points rather than particular details
an officer with a very high rank in the army

ex.en: There was general agreement that the kitchen needed repainting.
ex.zh: 大家普遍同意厨房需要重新刷漆。

ex.en: Although the general standard of education has improved, significant differences remain between urban and rural schools.
ex.zh: 尽管教育总体水平已有提高，城乡学校之间仍存在显著差异。

tip: in general意为“一般来说”，常用于概括。

senses.en: someone with exceptional intelligence or creative ability
exceptional natural ability in a particular area

ex.en: My sister is a genius at fixing broken toys.
ex.zh: 我姐姐修坏玩具特别有一手。

ex.en: Creative genius often develops when schools allow students to experiment rather than simply memorise facts.
ex.zh: 学校允许学生探索尝试，而非仅仅记忆知识时，创造天赋往往更容易得到发展。

col: a genius at｜在……方面极有才干的人
a stroke of genius｜绝妙的主意
tip: 指天才人物时可数；指非凡才能时通常不可数。

senses.en: Kind and careful, without roughness or force.
Mild in strength, movement, or effect.
Rising or falling gradually rather than steeply.

ex.en: Be gentle when you pick up the little kitten.
ex.zh: 抱起那只小猫时，动作要轻柔。

ex.en: Gentle exercise, such as walking or swimming, can improve physical health without placing excessive strain on joints.
ex.zh: 散步或游泳等温和运动可以改善身体健康，又不会给关节带来过大负担。

tip: 对人温柔用be gentle with sb。

senses.en: A man who behaves politely and considers other people.
A polite or formal way to refer to a man.

ex.en: A gentleman held the door open for us.
ex.zh: 一位绅士为我们扶住了门。

ex.en: The elderly gentleman described how public transport had improved his independence and access to community activities.
ex.zh: 这位年长的先生讲述了公共交通如何增强他的独立生活能力，并让他更方便地参加社区活动。

col: ladies and gentlemen｜女士们、先生们
tip: 复数为gentlemen；正式称呼男性时未必强调品行。

senses.en: the study of Earth's places, environments, and human activity
the physical features and arrangement of a particular area

ex.en: In geography today, we learned how rivers shape valleys.
ex.zh: 今天的地理课上，我们学习了河流如何塑造河谷。

ex.en: The geography of coastal regions influences settlement patterns and determines how communities respond to rising sea levels.
ex.zh: 沿海地区的地理特征影响聚居格局，并决定当地社区如何应对海平面上升。

tip: geography是地理学；geology是地质学。

senses.en: relating to Germany, its people, or its language
a person from Germany
the language spoken in Germany and some neighbouring countries

ex.en: We shared a traditional German cake after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们分着吃了一块传统德国蛋糕。

ex.en: German universities attract international students through research opportunities and a wide range of degree programmes.
ex.zh: 德国大学通过研究机会和丰富的学位课程吸引国际学生。

tip: 首字母须大写；指德语时通常不加冠词。

senses.en: a country in central Europe

ex.en: My cousin moved to Germany to study engineering.
ex.zh: 我的表亲搬到德国去学工程了。

ex.en: Germany has invested in renewable energy as part of its efforts to reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 德国投资可再生能源，以减少对化石燃料的依赖。

tip: Germany是国名；German可指德语、德国人或德国的。

senses.en: Something given freely to another person
A natural ability to do something well
To give something to someone as a present

ex.en: My sister wrapped the gift in bright yellow paper.
ex.zh: 姐姐用鲜黄色的纸把礼物包了起来。

ex.en: Schools should nurture each child's gift rather than judge everyone by the same narrow standards.
ex.zh: 学校应培养每个孩子的天赋，而不是用同一套狭隘的标准评判所有人。

col: a gift for languages｜语言天赋
tip: 表示天赋时常用 a gift for，后接名词或动名词。

ex.en: We made gingerbread during the holiday.
ex.zh: 假期里我们做了姜饼。

ex.en: The gingerbread house was covered with sweets.
ex.zh: 姜饼屋上装饰着糖果。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: A tall African animal with a long neck and spotted coat

ex.en: The giraffe stretched its neck to reach the highest leaves.
ex.zh: 那只长颈鹿伸长脖子去够最高处的叶子。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for maintaining healthy giraffe populations and preserving biodiversity in African grasslands.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地对于维持健康的长颈鹿种群和保护非洲草原的生物多样性至关重要。

col: a herd of giraffes｜一群长颈鹿
tip: 重音在第二音节，复数通常加-s。

senses.en: A female child or young woman

ex.en: The girl carefully carried her kitten into the house.
ex.zh: 那个女孩小心翼翼地把小猫抱进屋里。

ex.en: Ensuring that every girl can attend school is essential for reducing inequality and supporting economic development.
ex.zh: 确保每个女孩都能上学，对于减少不平等和促进经济发展至关重要。

tip: 成年女性正式称woman；girl不直接表示女朋友。

senses.en: to hand something to someone or let them have it
to provide something or cause someone to experience something
to hold an event or perform an action for others

ex.en: Please give your sister a clean towel after swimming.
ex.zh: 游泳后请给你妹妹一条干净的毛巾。

ex.en: Schools should give students opportunities to develop practical skills through projects that address real community needs.
ex.zh: 学校应通过解决社区实际需求的项目，让学生有机会培养实践技能。

col: give someone a chance｜给某人机会
tip: give sb sth＝give sth to sb；过去式gave。

senses.en: Feeling happy or pleased about something.
Willing and pleased to do something.

ex.en: I'm glad you came to dinner with us tonight.
ex.zh: 我很高兴你今晚来和我们一起吃饭。

ex.en: Many residents were glad that the council had decided to preserve the local park.
ex.zh: 许多居民都很高兴，地方议会决定保留当地的公园。

tip: 常作表语；用be glad to do或be glad that从句。

senses.en: A hard, usually transparent material used for windows and containers.
A drinking container, or the amount it holds.
Lenses held in a frame worn to improve sight.

ex.en: The ball hit the window and shattered the glass.
ex.zh: 球砸中了窗户，把玻璃打碎了。

ex.en: Recycling glass reduces demand for raw materials and can lower energy consumption in the manufacturing sector.
ex.zh: 回收玻璃能减少对原材料的需求，并可降低制造业的能源消耗。

tip: 玻璃不可数，玻璃杯可数；眼镜用复数glasses。

senses.en: A hand covering with separate sections for fingers and thumb.

ex.en: I found my missing glove under the kitchen chair.
ex.zh: 我在厨房椅子下面找到了丢失的那只手套。

ex.en: Healthcare workers should change disposable gloves between patients to reduce the risk of spreading infections.
ex.zh: 医护人员在接诊不同患者之间应更换一次性手套，以降低传播感染的风险。

col: a pair of gloves｜一副手套
tip: 一副手套用 a pair of gloves，注意 gloves 用复数。

senses.en: a sticky substance used to join things together
to join things together using glue

ex.en: Use a little glue to fix the paper wing.
ex.zh: 用一点胶水把纸翅膀粘好。

ex.en: Some packaging contains layers joined with glue, which can make the materials more difficult to recycle.
ex.zh: 有些包装的各层材料用胶粘合，这可能增加回收难度。

col: be glued to a screen｜盯着屏幕看
tip: 作名词通常不可数；be glued to可指目不转睛地看。

ex.en: We go to school by bus.
ex.zh: 我们乘公共汽车去上学。

ex.en: I went to the park with my family yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我和家人去了公园。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: Something you want to accomplish through effort.
A score made by sending a ball into a goal.
A frame or area players aim to send a ball into.

ex.en: My goal is to swim across the pool unaided.
ex.zh: 我的目标是不靠帮助游到泳池对面。

ex.en: Setting realistic goals can help university students manage their time and maintain motivation during demanding courses.
ex.zh: 设定切合实际的目标能帮助大学生管理时间，并在繁重的课程学习中保持动力。

tip: 目标用set或achieve；进球用score a goal。

senses.en: The supreme being worshipped in religions believing in one god.

ex.en: My grandmother thanks God before each meal at home.
ex.zh: 我祖母在家每次用餐前都会感谢上帝。

ex.en: Belief in God can influence people's values, charitable activities, and responses to difficult circumstances.
ex.zh: 对上帝的信仰可能影响人们的价值观、慈善活动及应对困境的方式。

col: faith in God｜对上帝的信仰
tip: 指唯一的神用God，通常不加冠词；泛指神用god。

senses.en: A valuable yellow metal used for jewellery and money
The medal awarded for first place in a competition
Made of gold or having its yellow colour

ex.en: My grandmother keeps her gold ring in a wooden box.
ex.zh: 我奶奶把她的金戒指放在一个木盒里。

ex.en: Demand for gold can increase during economic uncertainty, as investors seek assets they consider relatively safe.
ex.zh: 经济不确定时期，投资者会寻求他们认为相对安全的资产，黄金需求因此可能上升。

tip: gold作材料名通常不可数；a gold可指一枚金牌。

senses.en: Having the warm yellow colour of gold.
Especially valuable, favourable, or successful.

ex.en: The bread turned golden after twenty minutes in the oven.
ex.zh: 面包在烤箱里烤了二十分钟后变成了金黄色。

ex.en: International exchange programmes offer students a golden opportunity to develop language skills and understand different cultures.
ex.zh: 国际交流项目为学生提供了提高语言能力、了解不同文化的绝佳机会。

tip: golden多形容颜色；表示金制的通常用gold。

senses.en: Of a high or satisfactory standard.
Having a helpful or healthy effect.
Something that benefits people or is morally right.

ex.en: This bakery makes good bread with a crisp crust.
ex.zh: 这家面包店做的面包很好，外皮酥脆。

ex.en: Good public transport allows residents to reach essential services without relying on private cars.
ex.zh: 优质的公共交通让居民无需依赖私家车也能获得基本服务。

tip: good是形容词；修饰动作通常用well。

senses.en: the quality of being kind and morally good
the substances in food that help keep you healthy
used to express surprise, worry, or shock

ex.en: Her goodness showed when she shared her last sandwich.
ex.zh: 她把最后一个三明治分给别人，显露出善良的本性。

ex.en: Steaming vegetables can preserve more of their natural goodness than boiling them for long periods.
ex.zh: 与长时间水煮相比，蒸蔬菜能保留更多天然营养。

col: out of the goodness of your heart｜纯粹出于好心
tip: 作名词通常不可数；My goodness表示惊讶。

senses.en: Things produced for sale or transported for trade.
Movable possessions belonging to a person.

ex.en: The shop sells handmade goods from nearby villages.
ex.zh: 这家店出售附近村庄制作的手工商品。

ex.en: Transporting goods by rail rather than road can lower emissions and reduce congestion in urban areas.
ex.zh: 采用铁路而非公路运输货物可以降低排放，缓解城市拥堵。

tip: goods是复数名词；一件商品可说an item。

senses.en: A large waterbird with a long neck and webbed feet.
Meat from a goose, eaten as food.

ex.en: A white goose waddled across the path towards us.
ex.zh: 一只白鹅摇摇摆摆地穿过小路，朝我们走来。

ex.en: Protecting wetlands provides essential feeding grounds for wild geese and many other migratory birds.
ex.zh: 保护湿地能为野鹅及许多其他候鸟提供重要的觅食地。

tip: 复数为geese；表示鹅肉时不可数。

senses.en: the group of people officially controlling a country or region
the activity or system of controlling a country

ex.en: The government plans to build a new hospital nearby.
ex.zh: 政府计划在附近建一所新医院。

ex.en: Local government plays a crucial role in providing affordable housing and maintaining essential public services.
ex.zh: 地方政府在提供可负担住房和维持基本公共服务方面发挥着关键作用。

tip: 英国英语中，指政府群体时可接单数或复数谓语。

senses.en: a mark showing achievement, or a level of quality
a school year level, especially in the American system
to assess work or sort things by quality

ex.en: I got a good grade on my science project.
ex.zh: 我的科学课项目得了个好成绩。

ex.en: Teachers should grade assignments consistently so that students understand how their performance is assessed across different subjects.
ex.zh: 教师应按一致的标准给作业评分，让学生了解不同学科如何评估他们的表现。

col: get a good grade｜取得好成绩
tip: 表示年级时多用于美式英语；英式英语常用year。

senses.en: slowly over time, rather than all at once

ex.en: The sky gradually grew darker as we walked home.
ex.zh: 我们走回家时，天色渐渐暗了下来。

ex.en: Cities can gradually reduce traffic congestion by improving public transport and creating safer routes for cyclists.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过改善公共交通、为骑车者建设更安全的路线，逐步缓解交通拥堵。

tip: 强调变化缓慢发生，不只是动作速度慢。

senses.en: seeds of crops such as wheat, used as food
a very small hard piece of a substance
the natural pattern of lines in wood

ex.en: The farmer stored the grain in a dry barn.
ex.zh: 农民把粮食存放在干燥的谷仓里。

ex.en: Growing grain requires reliable water supplies, which are increasingly threatened by drought in many agricultural regions.
ex.zh: 种植谷物需要可靠的供水，而许多农业地区的供水正日益受到干旱的威胁。

tip: grain指粮食通常不可数；指单颗谷粒或细粒可数。

senses.en: The rules for combining words and changing their forms.

ex.en: Our teacher explains grammar using examples from everyday conversations.
ex.zh: 我们的老师用日常对话中的例子讲解语法。

ex.en: Although grammar instruction is important, language courses should also give learners opportunities to communicate in realistic situations.
ex.zh: 虽然语法教学很重要，语言课程也应让学习者有机会在真实情境中交流。

tip: 表示语法知识时不可数；一个语法错误用a grammar mistake。

senses.en: The father of your mother or father.

ex.en: My grandfather taught me how to grow tomatoes.
ex.zh: 我的祖父教过我如何种番茄。

ex.en: A grandfather who provides regular childcare can strengthen family bonds and support working parents.
ex.zh: 经常帮忙照顾孩子的祖父或外祖父能够增进家庭感情，并为在职父母提供支持。

tip: 不区分父系母系；外祖父可说maternal grandfather。

ex.en: My grandma grows flowers in her garden.
ex.zh: 我奶奶在花园里种花。

ex.en: Grandma taught me how to make dumplings.
ex.zh: 外婆教我包饺子。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: The mother of your father or mother.

ex.en: My grandmother grows fresh herbs on her kitchen windowsill.
ex.zh: 我的祖母在厨房窗台上种新鲜的香草。

ex.en: For many working parents, a grandmother provides essential childcare and helps maintain strong family connections.
ex.zh: 对许多在职父母来说，祖母或外祖母提供了不可或缺的育儿帮助，也有助于维系紧密的家庭关系。

tip: 可指祖母或外祖母；口语常用grandma。

ex.en: My grandpa walks with me after dinner.
ex.zh: 我爷爷晚饭后和我一起散步。

ex.en: Grandpa told us an interesting story.
ex.zh: 外公给我们讲了一个有趣的故事。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.zh: 祖父母或外祖父母之一
senses.en: The father or mother of one of your parents.

ex.en: Each grandparent brought a homemade dish to our picnic.
ex.zh: 每位祖辈都带了一道自制的菜来参加我们的野餐。

ex.en: A grandparent can provide valuable emotional support when both parents work outside the home.
ex.zh: 当父母都在外工作时，祖父母或外祖父母可以提供宝贵的情感支持。

col: visit your grandparents｜探望祖父母或外祖父母
tip: 单数指一位祖辈；复数可指祖父母或外祖父母。

senses.en: the son of your son or daughter

ex.en: Her grandson visits every Sunday and helps with cooking.
ex.zh: 她的孙子每周日都来看她，并帮忙做饭。

ex.en: Regular contact with a grandson or granddaughter can help older adults feel more socially connected.
ex.zh: 经常与孙辈联系能帮助老年人增强与社会的联系感。

col: youngest grandson｜最小的孙子或外孙
eldest grandson｜最大的孙子或外孙
tip: 不区分父系与母系，既指孙子也指外孙。

senses.en: A small round fruit growing in bunches on vines.

ex.en: She packed some grapes in my lunch box.
ex.zh: 她在我的午餐盒里装了一些葡萄。

ex.en: Farmers growing grapes may need more efficient irrigation systems as summers become hotter and drier.
ex.zh: 随着夏季变得更炎热、更干燥，葡萄种植者可能需要更高效的灌溉系统。

col: a bunch of grapes｜一串葡萄
tip: 单颗葡萄用a grape，一串用a bunch of grapes。

senses.en: A low plant with narrow green leaves covering the ground.

ex.en: We spread a blanket on the grass beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边的草地上铺了一条毯子。

ex.en: Replacing natural grass with artificial surfaces can reduce habitats for insects and increase local temperatures.
ex.zh: 用人造地面取代天然草地可能减少昆虫的栖息地，并使当地气温升高。

col: a blade of grass｜一片草叶
tip: 通常不可数；一片草叶用a blade of grass。

senses.en: To a large degree or by a large amount.

ex.en: Your clear directions greatly helped us find the cottage.
ex.zh: 你清楚的指路说明帮了大忙，让我们找到了那间小屋。

ex.en: Access to affordable childcare can greatly improve parents' ability to remain in employment and pursue further education.
ex.zh: 获得负担得起的托育服务，可以大大提升父母继续工作和接受进一步教育的能力。

tip: 常修饰动词，如greatly improve；不说greatly good。

senses.en: Having the colour of grass and most leaves.
Causing little harm to the environment.
The colour of grass and most leaves.

ex.en: She wore a green jacket to match her shoes.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件绿色夹克来搭配鞋子。

ex.en: Governments can encourage green transport by improving public services and building safer routes for cyclists.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过改善公共服务和修建更安全的自行车道来鼓励绿色出行。

col: go green｜采取环保生活方式
tip: 除颜色外，green常表示环保；形容人还可指缺乏经验。

senses.en: a glass or plastic building that keeps growing plants warm

ex.en: We grow tomatoes in the greenhouse throughout the winter.
ex.zh: 整个冬天，我们都在温室里种番茄。

ex.en: Greenhouse cultivation can extend growing seasons, although heating these structures may require considerable amounts of energy.
ex.zh: 温室种植可以延长生长季，但为这些设施供暖可能需要消耗大量能源。

col: grow plants in a greenhouse｜在温室里种植物
greenhouse gas emissions｜温室气体排放
tip: greenhouse是名词，也可作定语，如greenhouse gases。

senses.en: to welcome someone or say hello
to become noticeable when someone arrives or looks

ex.en: Our neighbours greeted us warmly when we moved in.
ex.zh: 我们搬来时，邻居们热情地向我们打招呼。

ex.en: Visitors are greeted by trained volunteers who explain the museum's collection and help them find their way.
ex.zh: 受过培训的志愿者迎接参观者，介绍博物馆的藏品并为他们指路。

col: greet someone warmly｜热情地问候某人
greet someone with a smile｜微笑着迎接某人
be greeted by｜受到迎接；首先看到
tip: greet直接接人；表示向某人问好不加to。

senses.en: Having a colour between black and white.
The colour between black and white.
Develop grey hair as you get older.

ex.en: A grey cat was sleeping on the windowsill.
ex.zh: 一只灰猫正在窗台上睡觉。

ex.en: Grey concrete buildings can appear less welcoming than neighbourhoods with colourful homes and abundant green space.
ex.zh: 灰色混凝土建筑可能不如拥有彩色住宅和充足绿地的街区亲切宜人。

tip: grey为英式拼写，gray为美式拼写。

senses.en: The solid surface of the earth.
Reasons or evidence supporting a belief, decision, or action.
To prevent an aircraft from flying.

ex.en: We spread a blanket on the ground beneath a tree.
ex.zh: 我们在树下的地面上铺了一条毯子。

ex.en: Planting trees helps the ground retain moisture and reduces the risk of soil erosion.
ex.zh: 植树有助于土地保持水分，并降低水土流失的风险。

tip: 表示理由常用复数grounds；ground也是grind的过去式。

senses.en: People or things together or connected by a shared feature.
Arrange people or things together, often according to shared features.

ex.en: A group of cyclists stopped outside the village bakery.
ex.zh: 一群骑行者在村里的面包店外停了下来。

ex.en: Teachers can group students by their learning needs to provide more effective support during classroom activities.
ex.zh: 教师可以根据学生的学习需求分组，以便在课堂活动中提供更有效的支持。

tip: a group of后常接复数名词；动词常用group A by B。

senses.en: To become bigger or develop over time.
To raise plants for food or other purposes.
To gradually become different in condition or feeling.

ex.en: We grow fresh herbs in pots beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房窗边的花盆里种新鲜香草。

ex.en: As cities grow, local authorities must invest in transport systems that serve expanding populations.
ex.zh: 随着城市发展，地方政府必须投资建设满足不断增长的人口需求的交通系统。

col: grow increasingly concerned｜变得越来越担忧
tip: 过去式grew，过去分词grown；表变得后接形容词。

senses.en: An adult, especially when described by or to children.
Adult, or behaving in a sensible and responsible way.

ex.en: Ask a grown-up to help you slice the bread.
ex.zh: 请一位大人帮你切面包。

ex.en: Children often develop grown-up attitudes towards responsibility when they participate in age-appropriate household tasks.
ex.zh: 孩子参与适合其年龄的家务时，往往会形成对待责任的成熟态度。

tip: 名词多用于儿童语境；正式写作宜用adult。

senses.en: An increase in size, amount, or level.
The process of growing physically or developing over time.
An unusual lump of tissue growing in or on the body.

ex.en: The rapid growth of our town surprised my grandparents.
ex.zh: 我们小镇的迅速扩张让我的祖父母感到惊讶。

ex.en: Governments should balance economic growth with environmental protection to ensure that rising prosperity does not exhaust natural resources.
ex.zh: 政府应平衡经济增长与环境保护，确保日益繁荣的经济不会耗尽自然资源。

tip: 表示增长通常不可数；a growth可指一个肿块。

senses.en: a person whose job is to protect people or places
to protect someone or something from danger or escape
a cover or barrier that prevents injury or damage

ex.en: The guard checked my ticket before opening the gate.
ex.zh: 警卫检查了我的票才打开大门。

ex.en: Museums employ trained staff to guard valuable collections while ensuring that visitors can enjoy them safely.
ex.zh: 博物馆雇用受过培训的工作人员保护珍贵藏品，同时确保游客能够安全地观赏。

tip: guard against表示防范某种风险或错误。

senses.en: Someone invited to visit a home or attend an event.
Someone staying at a hotel or similar accommodation.

ex.en: Each guest brought a dish to share at dinner.
ex.zh: 每位客人都带了一道菜，在晚餐时与大家分享。

ex.en: Hotels can encourage guests to conserve water by offering towel replacement only when requested.
ex.zh: 酒店可以仅在住客提出要求时更换毛巾，以鼓励节水。

tip: guest可指受邀客人，也可指付费的酒店住客。

senses.en: help or advice about what to do or how to proceed

ex.en: With your guidance, I finally planted the seeds correctly.
ex.zh: 在你的指导下，我终于把种子种对了。

ex.en: Schools should provide career guidance to help students make informed decisions about further education and employment.
ex.zh: 学校应提供职业指导，帮助学生在升学和就业方面作出明智的决定。

col: under someone's guidance｜在某人的指导下
tip: 不可数名词；说some guidance，不说a guidance。

senses.en: someone who leads people and explains places they visit
a book or resource giving useful information or instructions
to show someone the way or help them decide

ex.en: Our guide led us through the narrow market streets.
ex.zh: 导游带我们穿过市场里狭窄的街道。

ex.en: Teachers should guide students towards reliable sources rather than simply provide answers to every question.
ex.zh: 教师应引导学生寻找可靠的信息来源，而不是直接给出每个问题的答案。

col: guide someone through｜引导某人完成
guided tour｜有导游带领的游览
tip: 指南用a guide to；指导某人完成用guide someone through。

senses.en: A stringed musical instrument played by plucking or strumming.

ex.en: My sister plays the guitar beside the window every evening.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天晚上都在窗边弹吉他。

ex.en: Learning to play the guitar can help students develop patience, coordination, and confidence through regular practice.
ex.zh: 学习弹吉他能帮助学生通过规律练习培养耐心、协调能力和自信。

tip: 表示弹吉他，通常说play the guitar。

senses.en: a weapon that fires bullets or shells
a tool shaped like a gun that releases a substance

ex.en: The old gun was displayed behind glass at the museum.
ex.zh: 那支旧枪陈列在博物馆的玻璃展柜里。

ex.en: Strict gun storage regulations can help prevent accidents and improve safety within local communities.
ex.zh: 严格的枪支存放规定有助于预防事故，提高当地社区的安全水平。

col: a loaded gun｜装有弹药的枪
tip: gun也可指枪状工具，如glue gun（胶枪）。

senses.en: A room or building equipped for exercise and sport.
Physical exercise taught or practised at school.

ex.en: I usually go to the gym before work.
ex.zh: 我通常在上班前去健身房。

ex.en: Affordable gym membership can encourage regular exercise, although safe outdoor spaces are equally important for public health.
ex.zh: 价格实惠的健身房会员服务能鼓励定期锻炼，不过安全的户外空间对公共健康同样重要。

col: go to the gym｜去健身房
tip: gym是gymnasium的简称；去健身房用go to the gym。

senses.en: something you do regularly, often without thinking

ex.en: Checking my phone before breakfast has become a habit.
ex.zh: 早餐前查看手机已经成了我的习惯。

ex.en: Developing the habit of regular exercise during childhood can improve health throughout adult life.
ex.zh: 在童年时期养成规律锻炼的习惯，可以改善整个成年阶段的健康状况。

col: get into the habit of｜养成……的习惯
tip: 表示做某事的习惯，用habit of doing。

senses.en: Thin strands growing on the skin of people and animals.
A single strand growing from skin.

ex.en: She tied her hair back before making lunch.
ex.zh: 她做午饭前把头发扎了起来。

ex.en: Some workplaces are relaxing rules about hair and clothing to create a more inclusive environment.
ex.zh: 一些工作场所正在放宽对发型和服装的规定，以营造更包容的环境。

col: a strand of hair｜一缕头发
tip: 整体头发不可数；一根头发用a hair。

senses.en: An act of cutting hair, or the resulting hairstyle.

ex.en: I need a haircut before my cousin's wedding.
ex.zh: 表亲的婚礼之前，我需要理个发。

ex.en: Offering affordable haircuts at community centres can help trainee hairdressers gain practical experience while serving local residents.
ex.zh: 在社区中心提供价格实惠的理发服务，能让实习理发师在服务当地居民的同时积累实践经验。

tip: 说get或have a haircut，不说cut a haircut。

senses.en: one of two equal parts of something
equal to one of two equal parts of something
to an extent that is not complete

ex.en: I saved half of my sandwich for later.
ex.zh: 我留了一半三明治，准备晚点吃。

ex.en: Nearly half of the residents surveyed supported creating more green spaces in the city centre.
ex.zh: 受访居民中近一半支持在市中心增设绿地。

tip: 复数为halves；“半小时”用half an hour。

senses.en: an entrance area or passage connecting rooms in a building
a large room or building used for public gatherings
a building where university students live

ex.en: Please leave your wet shoes in the hall.
ex.zh: 请把湿鞋留在门厅里。

ex.en: The community hall provides an affordable space where residents can attend classes and organise local events.
ex.zh: 社区会堂为居民提供了一个价格实惠的场所，供他们上课和组织当地活动。

col: halls of residence｜大学学生宿舍
tip: 英式英语中，大学宿舍常称halls或halls of residence。

senses.en: A passage inside a building or space by its entrance

ex.en: Please leave your muddy boots in the hallway.
ex.zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子留在门厅里。

ex.en: Wide hallways and accessible entrances make public buildings easier to navigate for people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 宽敞的走廊和无障碍入口让行动不便的人更容易在公共建筑内通行。

tip: 既可指入口门厅，也可指连接房间的走廊。

ex.en: He ordered a hamburger and some juice.
ex.zh: 他点了一个汉堡包和一些果汁。

ex.en: We made a healthy hamburger at home.
ex.zh: 我们在家做了一个健康的汉堡包。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: The body part at the arm's end, with fingers and thumb.
Help with doing a task.
To give something to someone by holding it out.

ex.en: She held the warm cup in her left hand.
ex.zh: 她用左手握着温热的杯子。

ex.en: Practical workshops allow students to develop skills by making objects with their own hands.
ex.zh: 实践工作坊让学生通过亲手制作物品来培养技能。

col: give someone a hand｜帮某人一把
hand in an assignment｜提交作业
tip: give someone a hand表示帮忙；by hand表示手工。

senses.en: Attractive in appearance, especially describing a man.
Large and impressive in amount.

ex.en: My brother looks handsome in his new blue jacket.
ex.zh: 我哥哥穿着新的蓝色夹克，看起来很英俊。

ex.en: Companies investing in renewable energy may earn handsome profits as demand for cleaner alternatives continues to grow.
ex.zh: 随着对更清洁替代能源的需求持续增长，投资可再生能源的企业可能获得丰厚利润。

tip: 常形容男子英俊；形容利润或报酬时意为丰厚的。

senses.en: attach something above the ground, or remain suspended
fall or bend downwards loosely

ex.en: Please hang your wet coat beside the front door.
ex.zh: 请把你的湿外套挂在前门旁边。

ex.en: Museums often hang paintings at different heights to make their collections accessible to visitors of all ages.
ex.zh: 博物馆常将画作挂在不同高度，方便各年龄段的参观者欣赏馆藏。

col: hang on a wall｜挂在墙上
tip: 悬挂的过去式、过去分词均为hung；绞死则用hanged。

senses.en: to take place, often without being planned
to do or be something by chance

ex.en: What happened to the plant beside your window?
ex.zh: 你窗边那盆植物怎么了？

ex.en: Traffic accidents are more likely to happen when drivers are tired or distracted by mobile phones.
ex.zh: 驾驶员疲劳或因手机分心时，更容易发生交通事故。

col: happen to someone｜发生在某人身上
happen to do something｜碰巧做某事
tip: 不用于被动语态；happen to do表示碰巧做某事。

senses.en: In a way that shows pleasure or enjoyment.
Willingly and without objection.
With a fortunate or pleasing result.

ex.en: The children chatted happily while making sandwiches together.
ex.zh: 孩子们一起做三明治，开心地聊着天。

ex.en: Many residents would happily use public transport if services were more reliable and affordable.
ex.zh: 如果公共交通服务更可靠、价格更实惠，许多居民都会乐意乘坐。

tip: 句首Happily可表“幸好”，不只表示开心。

senses.en: The feeling of being pleased or satisfied with life.

ex.en: Her face shone with happiness when the puppy arrived.
ex.zh: 小狗到来时，她的脸上洋溢着喜悦。

ex.en: Strong social connections often contribute more to lasting happiness than the purchase of expensive possessions.
ex.zh: 与购买昂贵物品相比，牢固的社会联系往往更能带来持久的幸福。

tip: 通常不可数：表达幸福用happiness，不加a。

senses.en: Firm and not easily bent, cut, or pressed
Requiring considerable effort or being difficult to endure
With great effort, force, or intensity

ex.en: This bread is too hard to bite into.
ex.zh: 这块面包太硬了，咬不动。

ex.en: Many students work hard to gain qualifications, yet still find it difficult to secure stable employment.
ex.zh: 许多学生努力取得学历或资格，却仍然难以找到稳定的工作。

tip: hard可作副词“努力地”；hardly意为“几乎不”。

ex.en: She is a hard-working student.
ex.zh: 她是一名勤奋的学生。

ex.en: Hard-working team members finish their tasks on time.
ex.zh: 勤奋的团队成员会按时完成任务。

col: a hard-working student｜一名勤奋的学生
tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: almost not, or only to a very small degree
only just, before something else happens

ex.en: I could hardly hear you over the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 雨声太大，我几乎听不见你说话。

ex.en: Expanding roads alone is hardly sufficient to solve traffic congestion without improvements to public transport.
ex.zh: 如果不改善公共交通，仅靠拓宽道路几乎不足以解决交通拥堵。

tip: hardly意为几乎不，并非hard的副词形式。

senses.en: Physical injury or damage to someone's wellbeing or something's condition.
To injure someone or damage something.

ex.en: Too much sunlight can harm the leaves of this plant.
ex.zh: 阳光过强会损伤这种植物的叶子。

ex.en: Stricter controls on industrial waste could reduce the harm caused to rivers and protect local wildlife.
ex.zh: 加强对工业废弃物的管控可以减少河流受到的损害，并保护当地野生动物。

col: do more harm than good｜弊大于利
tip: 名词不可数；用do harm to，动词harm直接接宾语。

senses.en: causing or likely to cause damage or injury

ex.en: Too much direct sunlight can be harmful to your skin.
ex.zh: 过多的阳光直射会伤害你的皮肤。

ex.en: Stricter controls on industrial waste could reduce the harmful effects of water pollution on local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 加强对工业废物的管控，可以减少水污染对当地生态系统的有害影响。

tip: 表示对……有害用harmful to，不用harmful for。

senses.en: A peaceful relationship in which people cooperate and agree.
A pleasing match or agreement between different things.
Different musical notes played or sung together to support a melody.

ex.en: Our cats and dogs live together in perfect harmony.
ex.zh: 我们家的猫和狗相处得十分融洽。

ex.en: Community projects can promote social harmony by bringing residents from different backgrounds together to achieve shared goals.
ex.zh: 社区项目让不同背景的居民携手实现共同目标，从而促进社会和谐。

col: in harmony with nature｜与自然和谐共处
tip: 常用in harmony with表示与……和谐或一致。

senses.en: a covering worn on the head for protection or decoration

ex.en: I grabbed my hat before stepping into the sunshine.
ex.zh: 走到阳光下之前，我拿起了帽子。

ex.en: Wearing a wide-brimmed hat can reduce sun exposure, particularly for people who spend long hours working outdoors.
ex.zh: 戴宽檐帽可以减少日晒，对长时间在户外工作的人尤其有用。

tip: 戴着帽子用wear；戴上帽子的动作用put on。

senses.en: To dislike someone or something very strongly.
A very strong feeling of dislike towards someone or something.

ex.en: I hate finding wet socks on the bathroom floor.
ex.zh: 我特别讨厌在浴室地板上发现湿袜子。

ex.en: Although many commuters hate crowded trains, affordable public transport remains essential for reducing urban traffic.
ex.zh: 虽然许多通勤者讨厌拥挤的列车，但价格实惠的公共交通对于缓解城市交通拥堵仍然至关重要。

tip: hate后可接动名词或不定式，语气比dislike强。

ex.en: I have a new schoolbag.
ex.zh: 我有一个新书包。

ex.en: She had lunch with her classmates.
ex.zh: 她和同学们一起吃了午饭。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。

ex.zh: 他放学后踢足球。

ex.en: He is the student who helped me.
ex.zh: 他就是帮助我的那名学生。

senses.en: the body part containing the brain, eyes, and mouth
the person in charge of a group or organisation
to move or travel in a particular direction

ex.en: She shook her head when I offered more soup.
ex.zh: 我问她要不要再来点汤，她摇了摇头。

ex.en: Cyclists should wear suitable helmets to reduce the risk of head injuries when travelling on busy roads.
ex.zh: 骑车人在繁忙道路上行驶时应佩戴合适的头盔，以降低头部受伤的风险。

tip: head for＋地点表示“朝某地去”。

senses.en: Pain felt in the head.
A problem that causes worry or is difficult to manage.

ex.en: I have a headache, so I need some quiet.
ex.zh: 我头痛，需要安静一会儿。

ex.en: Ageing transport infrastructure has become a major headache for local authorities facing increasingly limited budgets.
ex.zh: 对于预算日益紧张的地方政府而言，老化的交通基础设施已成为一大难题。

tip: 表示一次头痛用a headache，通常说have a headache。

senses.en: The condition of someone's body and mind.
How well an organisation, economy, or system is functioning.

ex.en: Walking to work has really improved my health.
ex.zh: 步行上班确实改善了我的健康状况。

ex.en: Governments can improve public health by providing safe drinking water and affordable access to medical services.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过提供安全饮用水和可负担的医疗服务来改善公众健康。

tip: 通常不可数；表示身体健康用in good health。

senses.en: physically well and not suffering from illness
helping to maintain or improve health
successful, strong, or developing in a positive way

ex.en: Our cat stays healthy with regular exercise and checkups.
ex.zh: 我们家的猫通过经常运动和定期检查保持健康。

ex.en: Schools should provide healthy meals to support children's physical development and encourage better eating habits from an early age.
ex.zh: 学校应提供健康膳食，以促进儿童身体发育，并鼓励他们从小养成更好的饮食习惯。

col: a healthy lifestyle｜健康的生活方式
tip: 既可形容身体健康，也可形容饮食等有益健康。

senses.en: notice a sound through your ears
receive information about something
listen formally to evidence or arguments

ex.en: I can hear birds singing outside my bedroom window.
ex.zh: 我能听见卧室窗外的鸟鸣声。

ex.en: Local councils should hear residents' concerns before making decisions about major changes to public transport.
ex.zh: 地方议会在对公共交通作出重大调整前，应听取居民的顾虑。

col: hear from someone｜收到某人的消息
hear both sides｜听取双方意见
tip: hear强调听见；listen to强调主动听。过去式heard。

senses.en: The ability to notice sounds through your ears.
An official meeting to consider evidence or arguments.

ex.en: My grandfather's hearing improved after he received a hearing aid.
ex.zh: 祖父配了助听器后，听得更清楚了。

ex.en: A public hearing allows residents to express concerns before major construction projects receive official approval.
ex.zh: 公开听证会让居民能在大型建设项目获得正式批准前表达关切。

tip: 指听力时不可数；指听证会时可数。

senses.en: The organ that pumps blood around the body.
The part of someone associated with feelings and love.
The central or most important part of something.

ex.en: My heart beats faster when I run uphill.
ex.zh: 我跑上坡时，心跳会加快。

ex.en: Regular physical activity strengthens the heart and can reduce the risk of serious illness.
ex.zh: 经常运动能增强心脏功能，并降低患严重疾病的风险。

col: at the heart of｜处于……的核心
tip: by heart表示熟记；lose heart表示灰心。

senses.en: warmth or a high temperature
to make or become warmer
a race that decides who enters the next round

ex.en: We rested under a tree to escape the heat.
ex.zh: 我们在树下休息，躲避酷热。

ex.en: Cities can reduce extreme heat by planting trees and replacing dark surfaces with materials that reflect sunlight.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过植树以及用反射阳光的材料替换深色表面来缓解酷热。

tip: heat作名词指热，hot作形容词指热的。

senses.en: To a great degree or in large amounts.
With great weight, force, or effort.

ex.en: It rained heavily while we waited for the bus.
ex.zh: 我们等公交车时，雨下得很大。

ex.en: Countries that rely heavily on imported fuel are particularly vulnerable to sudden changes in global energy prices.
ex.zh: 严重依赖进口燃料的国家尤其容易受到全球能源价格突变的影响。

tip: 表示下大雨用rain heavily，不用rain strongly。

senses.en: Weighing a lot and often difficult to lift
Greater than usual in amount, strength, or intensity
Demanding considerable effort or causing serious difficulty

ex.en: This suitcase is too heavy for me to lift.
ex.zh: 这个行李箱太重了，我提不起来。

ex.en: Heavy traffic contributes to urban air pollution and increases the time people spend commuting.
ex.zh: 繁忙的交通加剧了城市空气污染，也增加了人们的通勤时间。

tip: 大雨用heavy rain，不用big rain。

senses.en: the measurement of how tall someone or something is
the distance of something above the ground or sea
the time when something is strongest or most successful

ex.en: She adjusted the chair's height so her feet reached the floor.
ex.zh: 她调节了椅子的高度，让双脚能够踩到地面。

ex.en: Restricting the height of new buildings can protect historic views and preserve the character of older neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 限制新建筑的高度可以保护历史景观，并保留老街区的特色。

col: average height｜平均身高；平均高度
at a height of｜在……的高度
at the height of｜在……的鼎盛时期
tip: height 是名词；形容人高用 tall，物体高可用 high。

senses.en: Make something easier or better for someone.
Support that makes a difficulty or task easier.

ex.en: Could you help me carry these bags upstairs?
ex.zh: 你能帮我把这些袋子提上楼吗？

ex.en: Affordable public transport can help residents access jobs and reduce their dependence on cars.
ex.zh: 价格实惠的公共交通可以帮助居民获得就业机会，并减少他们对汽车的依赖。

col: help someone with something｜帮助某人做某事
tip: help后接动词原形或to不定式均可。

senses.en: Making something easier to do or understand.
Willing to help other people.

ex.en: Your map was helpful when we explored the village.
ex.zh: 我们游览村庄时，你的地图帮了大忙。

ex.en: Clear feedback is particularly helpful for students who are learning to organise their ideas in academic essays.
ex.zh: 对于正在学习如何组织学术论文思路的学生来说，清晰的反馈尤其有帮助。

col: find something helpful｜觉得某物有帮助
tip: helpful可形容事物有用，也可形容人乐于助人。

senses.en: the female person or animal receiving an action
belonging to or connected with a female person or animal

ex.en: I called her after lunch to arrange a walk.
ex.zh: 午饭后我给她打了电话，约好一起散步。

ex.en: When a student requests additional support, teachers should help her access appropriate learning resources.
ex.zh: 当一名女学生请求额外支持时，教师应帮助她获取合适的学习资源。

tip: her可作宾语或接名词表所属；hers独立使用。

ex.en: The yellow coat is hers.
ex.zh: 这件黄色外套是她的。

ex.en: My desk is next to hers.
ex.zh: 我的课桌在她的课桌旁边。

col: a friend of hers｜她的一位朋友

ex.zh: 她自己制作了这张卡片。

ex.en: The girl looked at herself in the mirror.
ex.zh: 女孩看着镜子里的自己。

senses.en: Used informally to greet someone or attract their attention.

ex.en: Hey, you left your umbrella beside the door!
ex.zh: 喂，你把伞落在门边了！

ex.en: Informal greetings such as hey may be inappropriate when students first contact university staff by email.
ex.zh: 学生初次通过电子邮件联系大学教职员工时，使用hey这类非正式问候语可能不太合适。

tip: 适合熟人间打招呼；正式邮件避免使用。
